turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Mr. Hale. I have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about this zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Tell me why that happened.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Mr. Hale. I'm not here for pleasantries. You entered a zero before you called me. Why?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
"A machine flagged it." Ninety-four percent of what, exactly? Who decided that was enough to enter a mark, and did anyone ask Owen a single question before they did?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable." Your own school's procedure says a software result doesn't establish a concern on its own. Check section 4.3. So what else do you have?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Nobody made you enter it that afternoon. You chose to, without calling home. Show me what else you have, or we're done with that zero.
I hope you understand my position.
I understand your position. I'm asking you what evidence supports it.
